This '''[[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]]''' was a [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval]] commander in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was the second in command to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Miltin Takel]] in the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]], helping to patrol the Grand Admiral's homeworld of [[Gargon/Legends|Gargon]]. During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], his commanding officer was called away to the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] to witness the final defeat of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Left in command, the first officer followed up reports on [[Nagai/Legends|albino-skinned marauders]] that were being increasingly seen by citizens of the sector. During his search, the officer was joined by Grand Admiral [[Josef Grunger]], who came to aid in the hunt. During their search, the first officer received word of the Empire's defeat at Endor and the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor's]] death. Grunger, who had also heard the news, decided that the time was right to make a bid for the throne, and he fired on the first officer's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], disabling it. Grunger then took control of the sector and ousted Takel's forces from their former holdings.
